$comment: Educational schematic of the Ruwais complex. Positions are REPRESENTATIVE, not geographic. tag: public|approx|representative|not-public. capacity_bpd null = not public.

units.description_en: Light sweet Murban crude arrives by onshore pipeline from the Habshan processing hub. Before the CFP this fed nearly the whole complex. Route is public knowledge; the refinery-leg capacity is not published.
units.description_ar: يصل خام مربان الخفيف الحلو عبر خط أنابيب بري من حبشان.
units.why_en: Onshore Murban needs no tankers — it flows straight from the fields.
units.heavier_en: In sour-crude scenarios this line mostly bypasses Ruwais West: Murban goes to export and to Ruwais East instead.

units.description_en: Tankers deliver offshore Upper Zakum and third-party grades (Basrah, Kuwaiti crude) here. First Basrah cargo arrived April 2024 per MEES. Berth details are not public.
units.description_ar: تفرغ الناقلات هنا خام زاكوم العليا والخامات المستوردة مثل خام البصرة.
units.why_en: Seaborne receipt is what makes third-party crude shopping possible at all.
units.heavier_en: This is the busy front door in scenarios B and C.

units.description_en: Six schematic tanks segregate crude by grade so the CDU gets a steady, known diet. Tank colors here change with the scenario to show which grades are stored. Real tankage figures are not public.
units.description_ar: صهاريج تفصل الخام حسب النوع لتغذية وحدة التقطير بخليط ثابت ومعروف.
units.why_en: Refineries never run 'whatever just arrived' — storage buys blending control and time.
units.heavier_en: Grade segregation matters more: mixing 4% sulfur Basrah Heavy into a sweet tank would poison the plan.

units.description_en: Heats crude to ~350–370 °C and separates it by boiling point into gas/LPG, naphtha, kerosene, diesel and atmospheric residue. It changes nothing chemically — it only sorts molecules by size. Everything downstream exists to fix what distillation alone can't.
units.description_ar: تسخّن الخام وتفصله حسب درجة الغليان إلى غاز ونافثا وكيروسين وديزل ومتبقٍ جوي.
units.why_en: The sorting step: no refinery works without first splitting crude into workable cuts.
units.heavier_en: Heavier crude means less naphtha/kero out the top and much more residue out the bottom — CFP also upgraded metallurgy against sour corrosion.

units.description_en: Distills atmospheric residue again under vacuum, so big molecules boil without cracking into coke. Splits it into vacuum gasoil (hydrocracker feed) and vacuum residue. Vacuum lowers the boiling point instead of raising the flame.
units.description_ar: تقطّر المتبقي الجوي تحت تفريغ لفصل زيت الغاز الفراغي عن المتبقي الفراغي.
units.why_en: Recovers valuable gasoil trapped in residue that normal distillation would burn.
units.heavier_en: Runs harder: heavy crude can double the residue arriving here.

units.description_en: The heart of the Crude Flexibility Project (new, 2023): reactors soak sour atmospheric residue in hydrogen at high pressure, stripping out sulfur and metals. That makes heavy sour residue acceptable to the existing RFCC. Without the ARD, sour crude residue would wreck the RFCC catalyst.
units.description_ar: قلب مشروع مرونة الخام: تعالج المتبقي الجوي الحامضي بالهيدروجين لنزع الكبريت والمعادن قبل وحدة التكسير.
units.why_en: This single unit is why Ruwais West can now eat Upper Zakum and Basrah instead of Murban.
units.heavier_en: It IS the heavier-crude answer — idle on a Murban diet, flat out on Basrah.

units.description_en: One of the world's largest RFCCs: hot fluidized catalyst cracks big residue molecules into gasoline, LPG and propylene in seconds. The catalyst circulates continuously between reactor and regenerator, where coke deposits are burned off. This is the unit that turns bottom-of-the-barrel into the top of the price list.
units.description_ar: من أكبر وحدات التكسير التحفيزي في العالم: تكسّر جزيئات المتبقي الكبيرة إلى بنزين وغاز البترول المسال والبروبيلين.
units.why_en: Heavy molecules → lighter, more valuable products. It's the profit engine of Ruwais West.
units.heavier_en: Feed quality is everything: sour feed must pass the ARD first or metals and sulfur kill the catalyst and products go off-spec.

units.description_en: Cracks vacuum gasoil under very high hydrogen pressure, producing ultra-clean jet fuel and diesel. Unlike the RFCC it adds hydrogen while it cracks, so products come out nearly sulfur-free. The complement to the RFCC: RFCC makes gasoline, hydrocracker makes distillates.
units.description_ar: تكسّر زيت الغاز الفراغي تحت ضغط هيدروجين عالٍ لإنتاج وقود طائرات وديزل فائق النقاء.
units.why_en: Jet and diesel command premiums; this unit makes the cleanest barrels in the plant.
units.heavier_en: More VGO to process and dirtier feed — hydrogen consumption per barrel climbs steeply.

units.description_en: Removes sulfur and nitrogen from straight-run naphtha over a catalyst with hydrogen. Protects the reformer's platinum catalyst, which sulfur poisons instantly. Splits treated naphtha between the reformer and the isomerization unit.
units.description_ar: تنزع الكبريت من النافثا لحماية محفّز البلاتين في وحدة الإصلاح.
units.why_en: A cheap guard unit protecting a very expensive catalyst downstream.
units.heavier_en: Sour crude naphtha carries more sulfur — the unit works harder for the same barrels.

units.description_en: Hydrotreats the kerosene cut to jet-fuel specification: sulfur out, mercaptans (the smell) destroyed. Jet A-1 has strict international specs, so nearly every kero barrel passes through here.
units.description_ar: تعالج قطفة الكيروسين لتلبية مواصفات وقود الطائرات العالمية.
units.why_en: Airlines don't negotiate on fuel spec.
units.heavier_en: More sulfur in, more hydrogen burned, more H2S out — same jet spec regardless.

units.description_en: Deep-desulfurizes diesel to ~10 ppm sulfur (from thousands of ppm in sour crude). Also treats cracked cycle oil from the RFCC, which is harder to clean than straight-run diesel.
units.description_ar: تنزع الكبريت من الديزل حتى ١٠ أجزاء بالمليون تقريبًا.
units.why_en: Modern diesel markets accept nothing above ~10 ppm sulfur.
units.heavier_en: Basrah diesel cut can carry 20–40× the sulfur of Murban's — hydrogen demand jumps accordingly.

units.description_en: Selectively desulfurizes RFCC cracked gasoline while trying not to destroy its octane. A balancing act: hydrogen removes sulfur but also saturates the octane-rich olefins.
units.description_ar: تنزع الكبريت من بنزين وحدة التكسير مع الحفاظ على رقم الأوكتان.
units.why_en: Cracked gasoline is a third of the pool and the sourest part of it.
units.heavier_en: Even ARD-treated sour feed leaves more sulfur in RFCC gasoline than Murban did.

units.description_en: Rearranges low-octane light naphtha molecules into branched, higher-octane isomers. No cracking, no hydrogen consumed to speak of — just reshaping.
units.description_ar: تعيد ترتيب جزيئات النافثا الخفيفة لرفع رقم الأوكتان.
units.why_en: Cheapest octane in the refinery.
units.heavier_en: Less naphtha from heavy crude means this unit sees less feed.

units.description_en: Continuously-regenerating catalytic reformer: converts heavy naphtha into high-octane aromatic reformate and — crucially — co-produces hydrogen. Capacity is not public; the unit's existence is.
units.description_ar: تحوّل النافثا الثقيلة إلى ريفورمات عالي الأوكتان وتنتج الهيدروجين.
units.why_en: Makes the octane AND part of the hydrogen the treating units consume.
units.heavier_en: Heavy crude gives less naphtha, so less reformate and less by-product hydrogen — right when hydrogen demand rises. Double squeeze.

units.description_en: Amine solvent circulates through the plant scrubbing H2S out of gas streams; this CFP unit strips the H2S back out so the solvent can be reused. The concentrated H2S goes to sulfur recovery.
units.description_ar: تجدد محلول الأمين الذي يلتقط كبريتيد الهيدروجين من الغازات.
units.why_en: The plant's bloodstream for sulfur: every hydrotreater depends on it.
units.heavier_en: Sized up by the CFP precisely because sour crude multiplies H2S traffic.

units.description_en: Process water picks up H2S and ammonia throughout the plant; these CFP columns steam-strip both out before the water is reused or discharged. The stripped gas joins the H2S feed to sulfur recovery.
units.description_ar: تنزع كبريتيد الهيدروجين والأمونيا من مياه العمليات بالبخار.
units.why_en: You can't dump sour water and you can't reuse it dirty.
units.heavier_en: Sour crude roughly triples the sour-water load — hence new CFP strippers.

units.description_en: Separates the light gas streams from distillation and treating into fuel gas, propane and butane, and sweetens them. LPG for sale comes out of here.
units.description_ar: تفصل الغازات الخفيفة إلى غاز وقود وبروبان وبيوتان.
units.why_en: Nothing is wasted: even the lightest molecules become product or plant fuel.
units.heavier_en: CFP added this unit to handle changed gas make from sour operation.

units.description_en: Steam-methane reformer: natural gas + steam → hydrogen at ~900 °C over nickel catalyst. Built by the CFP because the ARD and harder-working hydrotreaters need far more hydrogen than the reformer by-product supplies.
units.description_ar: تنتج الهيدروجين من الغاز الطبيعي والبخار لتغذية وحدات المعالجة.
units.why_en: Hydrogen is the currency of sulfur removal — heavier, sourer crude means paying more of it per barrel.
units.heavier_en: Utilization climbs from low (Murban) toward flat-out (Basrah diet).

units.description_en: Claus units convert concentrated H2S into molten elemental sulfur — a sellable product — and the tail-gas unit scrubs what escapes, pushing recovery above 99.9%. The CFP added 1,100 t/d of capacity.
units.description_ar: تحوّل كبريتيد الهيدروجين إلى كبريت صلب قابل للبيع.
inputs: H2S from amine & sour water units
units.why_en: Every kg of sulfur that came in with the crude and didn't leave in products must exit here.
units.heavier_en: The hard ceiling on how sour the crude diet can get: feed sulfur can approach ~2,400 t/d on a Basrah Heavy diet vs ~400 t/d on Murban.

units.description_en: The original Ruwais West sulfur recovery train, sized for a sweet Murban diet. Its capacity is not public. The CFP addition dwarfs it.
units.description_ar: وحدة استخلاص الكبريت الأصلية المصممة لخام مربان الحلو.
units.why_en: Even sweet crude at 417,000 b/d yields hundreds of tons of sulfur a day.
units.heavier_en: Runs alongside the CFP train in sour scenarios.

units.description_en: Pipework where blendstocks are ratioed into finished grades: reformate + isomerate + cracked gasoline become gasoline; treated cuts become jet and diesel. Recipes shift with crude diet and season.
units.description_ar: خطوط تمزج المكونات لإنتاج الدرجات النهائية من البنزين والديزل.
units.why_en: Products are recipes, not single streams.
units.heavier_en: Recipes rebalance as cracked stocks grow relative to straight-run.

units.description_en: Finished gasoline awaiting export or domestic dispatch. Roughly 28–31% of the barrel on this plant thanks to the RFCC and reformer.
units.description_ar: تخزين البنزين النهائي للتصدير أو السوق المحلي.
units.heavier_en: Share of the barrel shrinks slightly as crude gets heavier.

units.description_en: Jet A-1 from the kerosene hydrotreater and hydrocracker.
units.description_ar: وقود الطائرات من وحدتي المعالجة والتكسير الهيدروجيني.
units.heavier_en: Straight-run kero shrinks with heavier crude; the hydrocracker partly compensates.

units.description_en: Ultra-low-sulfur diesel — consistently the largest product cut at ~31% of the barrel across all three crude diets.
units.description_ar: الديزل منخفض الكبريت، أكبر منتجات المصفاة حجمًا.
units.heavier_en: Held steady by RFCC cycle oil and hydrocracker diesel filling the straight-run gap.

units.description_en: The leftovers: vacuum residue and RFCC slurry that conversion couldn't upgrade, sold as marine/utility fuel oil. The tell-tale product — watch it roughly double from scenario A to C.
units.description_ar: المتبقيات التي لم يتم تحويلها، تباع كزيت وقود بحري.
units.why_en: Every refinery has a bottom; the question is how small conversion can make it.
units.heavier_en: Grows fastest of all products as crude gets heavier — the honest indicator of conversion limits.

units.description_en: Pressurized spheres holding propane and butane from the gas plant and RFCC.
units.description_ar: كرات مضغوطة لتخزين البروبان والبيوتان.

units.description_en: Polymer-grade propylene recovered from RFCC gas — feedstock for the neighboring Borouge petrochemical complex.
units.description_ar: بروبيلين من غاز وحدة التكسير، لقيم لمجمع بروج المجاور.
units.why_en: The refinery–petrochemical bridge: molecules worth more as plastic than as fuel.

units.description_en: Molten sulfur is solidified into granules and stockpiled for export — the UAE is one of the world's larger sulfur exporters.
units.description_ar: يُحبّب الكبريت المنصهر ويخزّن للتصدير.
units.why_en: A waste stream turned commodity.
units.heavier_en: Pile grows ~5–6× moving from Murban to a Basrah diet.

units.description_en: Product tankers load gasoline, jet, diesel, fuel oil and sulfur for export. Ruwais is export-oriented: domestic UAE demand takes only part of the slate.
units.description_ar: تحميل ناقلات المنتجات للتصدير.

units.description_en: Loading rack and product pipelines serving the UAE domestic market.
units.description_ar: محطة تحميل تخدم السوق المحلي الإماراتي.

units.description_en: Boilers and turbines supply steam and electricity; refinery fuel gas is the main fuel. Simplified here to one block.
units.description_ar: غلايات وتوربينات توفر البخار والكهرباء.

units.description_en: Seawater and cooling towers reject the heat every distillation and reaction step leaves behind.
units.description_ar: أبراج تبريد ومياه بحر لتصريف الحرارة.

units.description_en: Safety valve of the whole plant: during upsets, excess gas burns here instead of building pressure. A busy flare is a symptom, not a feature.
units.description_ar: صمام أمان المصفاة: يحرق الغاز الزائد أثناء الأعطال.
units.why_en: Safety.

units.description_en: The original ~420,000 b/d plant, still running light Murban-type crude. Shown as context only — this app details Ruwais West, where the CFP lives.
units.description_ar: المصفاة الأصلية، لا تزال تعمل بخام مربان الخفيف. تُعرض كسياق فقط.

units.description_en: ADNOC/Borealis polyolefins complex next door; takes refinery propylene and ethane-based feedstocks.
units.description_ar: مجمع بوليمرات يستقبل البروبيلين من المصفاة.

units.description_en: ADNOC's planned LNG export plant at Ruwais — unrelated to the refinery process, shown for site context.
units.description_ar: مشروع تصدير الغاز المسال المخطط في الرويس.

units.description_en: Adjacent lube base-oil plant using refinery streams; not detailed here.
units.description_ar: مصنع زيوت تشحيم مجاور، غير مفصّل هنا.
